The tool functions only accept categories "vegan" or "gluten-free". There's no "vegetarian" category. The user wants vegetarian and gluten-free. We can interpret that as "gluten-free" and "vegetarian" but we don't have a vegetarian category. We could ask clarifying question: do they want vegetarian or vegan?
